result.stdout:
Usage: clone|c [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Clone a Git repository to a specified destination

Options:
  -p, --destination-path <string>    Local path where the repository will be cloned [Required]
  -l, --repository-list <string>     List file containing repositories to clone, one line for repository [Required]
  -u, --repository-url <string?>     URL of the Git repository to clone, fallback to env GIT_URL_DEFAULT. Example: git@ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/MyOrg/MyProject
  -b, --branch <string?>             Specific branch to clone.
  -t, --timeout <int>                Maximum seconds to wait for cloning each repository. [Default: 60]

result.stdout:
Usage: update|u [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Update all Git repositories found in the specified path

Options:
  -p, --path <string>           Path to search for Git repositories. Default: current directory [Default: @"."]
  -b, --branches <string[]?>    Target branches to switch to (in order of priority). Default: develop, main, master.
  -r, --remote-name <string>    Remote name to fetch from. [Default: @"origin"]
  -t, --timeout <int>           Maximum seconds to wait for the remote of each repository. [Default: 60]
